coverage: database URLs, bearer/access tokens, JWTs, and secret controls

ordinary_log_boundary: Application logging is installed through the root-handler filter before the permitops logger is created; no raw PII fixture is part of a release manifest. Test sentinels are confined to the adversarial test module.
method: Field-aware structured redaction plus narrowly scoped credential and labeled-identifier fallback patterns; arbitrary digit strings are not globally rewritten.
